title: 第三章 险避死劫坠蛮荒第二章 裁决暗芒悄噬魂
content_zh:
;;
那扇门在身后合拢的瞬间。
楚夜感觉到一股无法抗拒的力量，像一只无形的巨手，狠狠拍在他们四人身上。
——
“轰——！！！”
四个人从万丈高空坠落！
不是飞。
是真的坠。
像四颗流星，拖着长长的尾焰，砸向地面。
——
楚夜拼命睁开眼睛。
风像刀子一样刮在脸上。
他低头，看见脚下是一片无边无际的蛮荒大地。
山川如巨龙匍匐。
河流如银蛇蜿蜒。
森林如墨绿色的海洋，一望无际。
但离他越来越近。
近到能看清那些参天古树的树冠。
近到能看清那些在山林间奔跑的妖兽。
近到——

“砰——！！！”
——
楚夜砸在地上。
不是直接砸。
是砸穿了三棵古树，又在地上犁出一道三十丈长的深沟，最后撞在一块三丈高的巨石上。
巨石轰然炸裂！
碎石飞溅！
烟尘弥漫！
——
他趴在那堆碎石里。
浑身每一块骨头都在响。
每一寸肌肉都在抖。
每一口呼吸都带着血沫。
但他还活着。
——
他挣扎着爬起来。
四处看。
月婵在左边三十丈外。
她落在一片灌木丛里，那些带刺的枝条把她扎成了刺猬。
但她还活着。

阿蛮在右边五十丈外。
content_en:
;;
The moment the door closed behind you.
Chu Ye felt an irresistible force, like an invisible giant hand, slapping the four of them hard.
——
"Boom——!!!"
Four people fell from a height of ten thousand feet!
Not flying.
It really fell.
Like four meteors, dragging long tail flames, they hit the ground.
——
Chu Ye desperately opened his eyes.
The wind blew on my face like a knife.
He lowered his head and saw an endless expanse of wild land beneath his feet.
The mountains and rivers are like a prostrate dragon.
The river winds like a silver snake.
The forest is like a dark green ocean, stretching as far as the eye can see.
But getting closer to him.
Close enough to see clearly the crowns of those towering old trees.
Close enough to see clearly the monsters running through the mountains and forests.
So close——
"Bang——!!!"
——
Chu Ye hit the ground.
Not directly smashed.
It smashed through three ancient trees, plowed a deep trench thirty feet long in the ground, and finally hit a three-foot-high boulder.
The boulder exploded!
Gravel splashes!
Smoke and dust filled the air!
——
He lay in the pile of rubble.
Every bone in the body was ringing.
Every muscle is shaking.
Every breath was laced with blood.
But he is still alive.
——
He struggled to get up.
Look around.
Yue Chan is thirty feet away on the left.
She landed in a bush, and the thorny branches transformed her into a hedgehog.
But she's still alive.
Ah Man is fifty feet away on the right.
